title: Monthly housing market data for Texas MLS areas, 2000-2015 — tx_housing_markets
text: cleaned version ggplot2::txhousing, one row per market area per month, plus inflation-adjusted median prices. Used explore Texas housing markets changed , 2008 financial crisis.

title: Monthly housing market data for Texas MLS areas, 2000-2015 — tx_housing_markets
Monthly housing market data for Texas MLS areas, 2000-2015 — tx_housing_markets
text: tibble 8,602 rows 11 columns: area Multiple listing service (MLS) area. cities, counties regions, Collin County Bay Area. date month figures refer , stored first day month. year Year. month Month, 1 (January) 12 (December). period Phase housing cycle: Pre-crisis (2000-2006), Downturn (2007-2010) Recovery (2011-2015). cut-offs follow total sales across 46 areas, peaked 2006 lowest 2010. sales Number homes sold. volume Total value sales, US dollars. median Median sale price, US dollars, reported time (adjusted inflation). median_real Median sale price adjusted inflation, July 2015 US dollars, using Consumer Price Index US South region. listings Total active listings. inventory Months inventory: time take sell current listings current pace sales.

title: Monthly housing market data for Texas MLS areas, 2000-2015 — tx_housing_markets
text: Housing data: originally collected Texas &M University (TAMU) Real Estate Center, https://trerc.tamu.edu/. package uses copy distributed ggplot2 package ggplot2::txhousing. Inflation data: U.S. Bureau Labor Statistics, Consumer Price Index Urban Consumers: Items South (CUUR0300SA0), retrieved FRED, Federal Reserve Bank St. Louis, https://fred.stlouisfed.org/series/CUUR0300SA0.

title: Monthly housing market data for Texas MLS areas, 2000-2015 — tx_housing_markets
text: data run January 2000 July 2015, 2015 partial year. median_real converts month's median price July 2015 dollars, prices different years can compared fairly. uses CPI US South region, includes Texas, monthly CPI published Texas alone. areas missing values, particularly listings inventory; kept NA rather removed. script used prepare data data-raw/tx_housing_markets.R package source.

what: txhome: Explore How Texas Housing Markets Weathered the 2008 Financial Crisis — txhome-package
title: txhome: Explore How Texas Housing Markets Weathered the 2008 Financial Crisis — txhome-package
text: Provides cleaned monthly housing market data 46 Texas market areas 2000 2015, including median prices adjusted inflation, function summarises far market fell 2008 financial crisis quickly recovered, interactive Shiny app comparing resilience different markets. Housing data originally TAMU Real Estate Center, distributed 'ggplot2' package; inflation data U.S. Bureau Labor Statistics, retrieved FRED.
